input.summary: Make Ono's at-will termination right available from the Effective Date on 30 days' notice with a pro rata refund of prepaid fees, and confirm Array has no convenience termination right.
input.comment: [Playbook] Our convenience exit should not be blocked until a redacted date after First Commercial Sale of both Products, and the notice period should be fixed at thirty (30) days with a pro rata refund of any fees prepaid for post-termination periods. We have also confirmed expressly that Array has no convenience termination right; we can discuss 60-90 days' notice as a fallback.

ops.oldText: 13.2 Termination by Ono without Cause. Commencing on the later of (i) [ * ] of the First Commercial Sale of the Binimetinib Product in the Ono Territory, or (ii) [ * ] of the First Commercial Sale of the Encorafenib Product in the Ono Territory, Ono shall have the right to terminate this Agreement, for any reasons by giving [ * ] advance written notice to Array which shall be accompanied by the rationale for such termination.
ops.newText: 13.2 Termination by Ono without Cause. Ono shall have the right to terminate this Agreement at any time, for any reasons by giving thirty (30) days' advance written notice to Array which shall be accompanied by the rationale for such termination, and Array shall refund to Ono on a pro rata basis any fees prepaid by Ono for the period after the effective date of such termination. Array shall have no right to terminate this Agreement for convenience.
